Bootstrap calibration with a flexible curve

Source: R/csdg_calibration_bootstrap.R
csdg_calibration_bootstrap.Rd

Estimates calibration-in-the-large, the free calibration intercept and slope, prediction-error summaries, and a flexible calibration curve from out-of-fold predictions. Percentile intervals can use a respondent bootstrap or a cluster bootstrap, optionally sampling clusters independently within strata. The bootstrap conditions on the supplied predictions unless the complete fitting pipeline is rerun by the caller. The uniform_grid_mean_absolute_calibration_error is the arithmetic mean of the absolute difference between the flexible calibration curve and the identity line at equally spaced prediction-grid points. $$|\mathcal{G}_{f}|^{-1}\sum_{p_g\in\mathcal{G}_{f}} |\widehat{m}(p_g)-p_g|$$ Here, G_f contains the declared grid points for which the flexible-curve estimate is finite. The grid spans the empirical 0.01 and 0.99 prediction quantiles for classification and the empirical 0.005 and 0.995 prediction quantiles for regression, using quantile type 8. Each grid point with a finite curve estimate receives equal weight, so the statistic is a discrete grid mean and not a numerical approximation to an integral under an empirical or continuous prediction distribution. The former name integrated_absolute_calibration_error remains in returned tables only as a deprecated alias.

Usage

csdg_calibration_bootstrap(
  predictions,
  task_type = NULL,
  positive = NULL,
  bins = 10L,
  cluster = NULL,
  strata = NULL,
  repetitions = 1000L,
  confidence = 0.95,
  grid_points = 101L,
  span = 0.75,
  curve_method = c("loess", "regression_spline"),
  spline_df = 4L,
  seed = 20260201L,
  workers = 1L,
  collapse_repeats = TRUE
)

Arguments

predictions

A CSDGResample or prediction data frame accepted by csdg_calibration().

task_type

Optional task type, either "classif" or "regr".

positive

Positive class label for binary classification.

bins

Number of equal-frequency bins retained as a descriptive diagnostic.

cluster

Optional cluster vector, named vector indexed by row_id, or column name in predictions.

strata

Optional stratum vector, named vector indexed by row_id, or column name in predictions. When supplied with cluster, clusters are sampled independently within strata.

repetitions

Number of bootstrap replicates.

confidence

Confidence level for pointwise percentile intervals.

grid_points

Number of prediction values used for the flexible calibration curve.

span

Loess span for the flexible curve.

curve_method

Flexible-curve estimator, either direct local-linear "loess" or a natural cubic "regression_spline".

spline_df

Degrees of freedom for curve_method = "regression_spline".

seed

Random seed.

workers

Number of local worker processes used to evaluate already drawn bootstrap samples. Values greater than one use forked processes where supported and otherwise fall back to serial evaluation.

collapse_repeats

Whether repeated predictions for the same row are averaged before calibration.

Value

A list with point estimates and percentile intervals in summary, a flexible calibration curve with pointwise intervals in curve, descriptive bins in bins, bootstrap replicates, estimand definitions, an explicit deprecated-alias mapping in metric_aliases, a grid_specification, resampling metadata, and limitations.
